easy.q: In what year did the Barbie movie starring Margot Robbie hit theaters?
easy.fact: It was the highest-grossing film worldwide in 2023.

easy.q: In what year was King Charles III crowned at Westminster Abbey?
easy.fact: His coronation took place on May 6, about eight months after he became king.

easy.q: How many stars are on the flag of Texas?
easy.fact: The flag was adopted in 1839, when Texas was its own republic.

easy.q: How many races make up horse racing's Triple Crown?
easy.fact: They are the Kentucky Derby, the Preakness Stakes and the Belmont Stakes.

easy.q: How many hosts make up the Fab Five on Netflix's Queer Eye?
easy.fact: The Netflix reboot premiered in 2018 and has won several Emmys.

medium.q: NASA introduced its first astronaut class, the Mercury group, in 1959. How many astronauts were in it?
medium.fact: Alan Shepard, one of the group, became the first American in space in 1961.

medium.q: How many seasons of NBC's The Good Place were made?
medium.fact: Kristen Bell starred as Eleanor Shellstrop.

medium.q: How many emirates make up the United Arab Emirates?
medium.fact: Abu Dhabi is the largest of the seven.

medium.q: How many feet off the ground is the crossbar on an NFL goalpost?
medium.fact: The uprights rise at least 35 feet above the crossbar.

medium.q: In Jules Verne's famous novel, Phileas Fogg bets he can go around the world in how many days?

hard.q: To the nearest year, how long did Emperor Hirohito reign over Japan?
hard.fact: His era is known in Japan as Showa, meaning 'enlightened peace.'

hard.q: How many weeks did Despacito spend at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100?
hard.fact: That tied the record then held by Mariah Carey and Boyz II Men's One Sweet Day.

hard.q: How tall is the Matterhorn, to the nearest foot?
hard.fact: It straddles the border between Switzerland and Italy.

hard.q: How many yards long is a regulation polo field?
hard.fact: That's about the length of three football fields.
